answer: Give every agent a relay race across the meadow: to stay verified, its identity token must hop through four randomly assigned knoll checkpoints, each stamping it within a 90-second window, before reaching the final ledge. Each checkpoint serves at most five tokens per epoch, so a farmer running a hundred clones needs 400 scarce checkpoint slots at once and most clones miss the window and lose standing, while one honest agent needs only four stamps and passes easily.
